name: Fix App Problems
description: Help troubleshoot specific application issues by checking if the app is installed, running, or consuming excessive resources
prompt: Use check_installed_software and list_running_apps. Report: is the app installed? Is it running or stuck? Then give the fix — usually force-quit and reopen. Give platform-correct instructions (Mac: Apple menu > Force Quit; Windows: Ctrl+Alt+Delete > Task Manager).
